name: Sanwaraya
overview: An intricate exploration of human ethics, temptation, and the fragile nature of self-control. The narrative follows individuals whose lives collide through shared psychological struggles and deep-seated social friction. As personal desires clash with moral boundaries, each person is pushed toward an ultimate breaking point. Every choice carries heavy consequences, where a single lapse in restraint threatens to expose hidden secrets, shatter relationships, and permanently alter family futures.
